text: wyckoff: "shakeout-and-recovery inside a markup." A recovery is not an O'Neil buy point; C16 tests the breakout day, and day_vol 1.35 is just under 1.40. A near miss is still a miss. Group leadership at a new high is right and I credit it; no coil read leaves the base unread (R3). This is the closest oppose I hold. What clears me: day_vol 1.40 or more on a push over bar_high, and I move to SUPPORT.
